api_endpoints.description: List all commands with optional filtering (category, status, auto_invoke, search)
Get condensed command summary for command palette
Get detailed info for a specific command, optionally with raw markdown content
Get raw markdown content from harness/commands/{id}.md
Get all commands with auto-invoke enabled
List all brainstorm ideas with optional status filter
Create a new command idea for brainstorming
Get details for a specific idea
Update an existing idea (name, description, status, priority, etc.)
Vote on an idea to help prioritize (upvote/downvote)
Add a discussion note to an idea
Promote an idea to a real command (creates command entry)
Delete an idea from the brainstorm list
Create a new category for organizing commands
Sync commands from harness/commands/ directory to data store
Check sync status between data store and file system
Search across commands and ideas by query string

SlashCommandIdea.name: string - proposed command name
SlashCommandIdea.description: string - what this command would do

CommandTrigger.hook_name: string|null - the agent harness hook name

idea_list.ideas: SlashCommandIdea[] - sorted by priority, then votes

summary: Created a comprehensive Slash Command Center API module with 19 endpoints for managing the agent harness commands. Supports: command discovery via file scanning, brainstorming with ideas workflow (create, vote, promote), auto-invoke configuration with triggers, categories for organization, and search functionality. The module scans harness/commands/*.md files and syncs to IHIM/data/slash_commands.json.
key_features: File system sync - discovers commands from harness/commands/*.md
Brainstorming workflow - ideas can be created, voted on, and promoted to commands
Auto-invoke configuration - commands can be triggered by events, schedules, conditions, or hooks
Category organization - commands grouped into categories with icons
Search functionality - search across commands and ideas
Markdown content access - get raw .md content for editing/viewing
handoff_notes: @frontend-dev: API is ready. Endpoints return JSON with 'success' boolean. See response_formats for data shapes. Key endpoints for UI: GET /api/slash-commands/summary for command palette, GET /api/slash-commands for full list, POST /api/slash-commands/ideas for brainstorming. POST /api/slash-commands/sync to refresh from file system.
